entities.summary: Sir Thomas Lauder Brunton, 1st Baronet, was a British physician who is most-closely associated with the use of amyl nitrite to treat angina pectoris. Lauder Brunton was a physicians & medical pioneers from Roxburgh (1844-03-14, Roxburgh–1916-09-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
